q1_issues.issue: "the search" is an event-denoting noun that giving it up terminates, so the event-object clause of the Patient/Theme test (whose enumeration includes the near-synonym "call off") arguably requires Patient rather than Theme.

q2_gaps: Patient-vs-Theme for a terminative verb (give up / abandon) whose object is an ongoing event-denoting noun: the event-object list names scheduling verbs plus "call off", and it is not stated whether ending an activity already underway counts as changing "whether or when it happens"
notes: Everything else matches the instruction set: the phrasal verb is kept whole as give_up with no genus, rescue_team is fused with the head genus only (noun modifier correctly not exposed), and the bare simple present correctly takes no status atom.
